description: Search US state business-entity registries (Secretary of State) by company name, FL, NY, CO, OR, CT, PA, NJ, MA, and TX (Comptroller franchise-tax registrations). Returns each match with entity number, legal name, entity type, status, formation date, principal address, registered agent (an agent's address only when the agent is a business), and the state source, plus data_as_of per state. Name matching is "starts with"; with state given, if nothing starts with the name it retries as "contains" (an all-state search does not, because that retry scans a whole register). Legal-form spellings (LLC / Limited Liability Company, Inc / Incorporated, Corp / Corporation), a trailing full stop and & vs and are treated as the same name, and the same name with its spaces run together or split apart (RealValidation / Real Validation) is found too, and each result carries a `match` field (exact, legal_form_variant, spacing_variant or name_prefix). Omit state to search every covered state at once. NJ answers name searches only (name, entity ID, city, type, incorporation date; no status or officers). Use the entity_number with sos_entity for officers. Sourced from each state's official registry publications.

name.description: Company name or its beginning, e.g. "Publix Super Markets" or "Coors".

state.description: Two-letter state. One of FL, NY, CO, OR, CT, TX, PA, NJ, MA. Omit to search all.

status.description: Filter by status (default any). NY, OR and PA publish active entities only.

name: sos_search
title: Sos Search
